title: Harmonious Crispy Italian Veal Ossobuco
description: A fresh and crispy Italian dish featuring veal ossobuco with fermented black beans, finished to an al-dente texture, suitable for Jain-friendly diets. This romantic dish is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the veal shanks with salt and pepper.
Dredge the veal shanks in flour, shaking off excess.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the veal shanks until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the veal shanks from the pot and set them aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white wine, vegetable broth, and tomato paste to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the veal shanks to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the veal shanks for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone.
